name: lchase
description: Lawrence Chase's engineering skills for agentic development workflows.

plugins.name: smart-review
plugins.description: Multi-lens code review of a diff: six specialized lenses (spec-conformance, correctness, security, performance, design, tests) merged into one deduplicated, severity-ranked verdict. Fast single-pass (min) and orchestrated ensemble (max) modes.

plugins.name: tldraw
plugins.description: Turn a natural-language description of a flowchart, architecture diagram, process map, or state machine into an editable tldraw document (.tldr) plus a rendered PNG/SVG. Provides the /tldraw:diagram skill.

plugins.name: test-drive
plugins.description: Record a before/after test drive of a UI change: /test-drive:baseline records the app before you edit, /test-drive:compare replays the same scripted browser scenario after the change and composes a labeled side-by-side video with a deterministic pass/warn/fail verdict.
